title: Kiosk-mode diagnostics: compact observability screenshot pack for onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a compact, reusable screenshot pack for the Console 'first-run' onboarding flow focused on runtime diagnostics. Deliverables: 1) three layout variants (three-up horizontal hero, stacked card list, and single compact kiosk tile) showing latency summaries (p50/p95), cost-per-token sparkline, micro-trace (mini-flamegraph), KV-cache hit-rate donut, and token provenance timeline; 2) annotated Figma frames and copy-ready microcopy for docs; 3) export artifacts (1x, 2x retina PNG, SVGs for icons, and grayscale accessible variants). Acceptance criteria: images match Console palette, pass 4.5:1 contrast for key text, include explanatory tooltip wireframes, export sizes match docs spec (960x540, 1200x675, 420x240), and final assets uploaded to the onboarding Drive folder. Scope notes: this ticket is visual/asset creation only — integration into the quickstart markdown and runtime code is tracked separately. Technical constraints: use staging runtime metrics (staging.redwood-inference.net/dashboard/mock) to capture realistic values; avoid production data. Coordinate with ENG for KV-cache metrics and PM for messaging.
